title: ConfSets package: Confidence sets for functional ICC in test–retest settings
text: data_TEST data_RETEST data generated using test_retest_generator function based Seydi MR, Pini , Pataky TC, Schelin L. Confidence sets intraclass correlation coefficients test–retest curve measurements. Journal Biomechanics. 2024 Aug 1;173:112232. paper. Simulated data generated using functional two-way mixed model: Yij(t)=fi(t)+cj(t)+ϵij(t), Y_{ij}(t) = f_i(t) + c_j(t) + \epsilon_{ij}(t), Yij(t)Y_{ij}(t) represents observed function individual ii time tt column jj (test retest session). term fi(t)f_i(t) true function (curve) individual =1,…,ni = 1, \dots, n time tt, cj(t)c_j(t) fixed within-individual (column) effect j=1,2j = 1, 2, ϵij(t)\epsilon_{ij}(t) denotes error function. fi(t)f_i(t) ϵij(t)\epsilon_{ij}(t) can expressed : fi(t)=∑p=1Kαipϕp(t), f_i(t) = \sum_{p=1}^{K} \alpha_{ip} \phi_p(t), ϵij(t)=∑p=1Kαijp′ϕp(t), \epsilon_{ij}(t) = \sum_{p=1}^{K} \alpha'_{ijp} \phi_p(t), ϕp(t),p=1,…,K\phi_p(t), \, p = 1, \dots, K cubic B-spline basis functions. coefficients basis functions equations assumed independent normally distributed: αip∼N(μpf,σpB2), \alpha_{ip} \sim N(\mu_{p_f}, \sigma^2_{p_B}), αijp′∼N(μpe,σpe2), \alpha'_{ijp} \sim N(\mu_{p_e}, \sigma^2_{p_e}), μpf\mu_{p_f} μpe\mu_{p_e} mean parameters, σpB2\sigma^2_{p_B} σpe2\sigma^2_{p_e} variance parameters. Since fi(t)f_i(t) represents true curve individual, variation individual curves captured variance parameters σB=(σ1B,…,σKB)\sigma_B = (\sigma_{1_B}, \dots, \sigma_{K_B}). vector mean values KK-basis function coefficients individual denoted μf=(μ1f,…,μKf)\mu_f = (\mu_{1_f}, \dots, \mu_{K_f}). simulation, fi(t)f_i(t) ϵij(t)\epsilon_{ij}(t) generated creating coefficients (αip\alpha_{ip} αijp′\alpha'_{ijp}) cubic B-spline (order = 4) K=5K = 5 basis functions domain [0,100][0, 100]. parameters used μf=(0,5,0,−5,0)\mu_f = (0, 5, 0, -5, 0) σpe=1\sigma_{p_e} = 1. test-retest effect function cj(t),j=1,2c_j(t), j=1,2 assumed constant entire time interval, cj(t)=cjc_j(t)=c_j, |cj||c_j| attaining values 0.3. variance parameters basis function coefficients set σB=(2.5,5,5,5,2.5)\sigma_B = (2.5, 5, 5, 5, 2.5). number individuals set n=30n = 30, number evaluation points set 100.
code: test_retest_generator <- function(sigma_B, mu_f, c_j, n, time_point = 100){    c_i=c(c_j,-c_j) #the column effect   sigma_E=c(1,1,1,1,1) #sigma error   ncoef = 5 # number of basis coefficients   domain = seq(0,100,len=time_point) # domain   sigma_B_diag = diag(sigma_B) # covariance matrix between basis coefficients   sigma_E_diag = diag(sigma_E) # covariance matrix error term basis coefficients   n_order = 4 #order of bsplines   basis = create.bspline.basis(range(domain),nbasis=ncoef,norder=n_order) # b spline basis   mucoef = mu_f #mean of basis coef   mue=rep(0,ncoef) #mean of error    c_e_i  = rmvnorm(n,mucoef,(sigma_B_diag)^2) #random basis coef for between individuals   c_e_1  = rmvnorm(n,mue,(sigma_E_diag)^2) #random basis coef for error in test   c_e_2  = rmvnorm(n,mue,(sigma_E_diag)^2) #random basis coef for error in retest    # functional format   f_e_i = fd(coef=t(c_e_i),basisobj=basis)   f_e1 = fd(coef=t(c_e_1),basisobj=basis)   f_e2 = fd(coef=t(c_e_2),basisobj=basis)    #discretize curves   e_i  = t(eval.fd(domain,f_e_i))   e1   = t(eval.fd(domain,f_e1))   e2   = t(eval.fd(domain,f_e2))     y1 = e_i + c_i[1] + e1 #test   y2 = e_i + c_i[2] + e2 #retest    # return the test and retest data   return(list(Test=as.matrix(y1),Retes=as.matrix(y2))) }    library(fda) library(mvtnorm) set.seed(123) Data <- test_retest_generator(sigma_B = c(2.5,5,5,5,2.5),                                                  mu_f = c(0,5,0,-5,0), c_j = 0.3,                                                  n = 30, time_point = 100)

title: Confidence Sets for Functional ICC in Test-Retest Studies
text: functional_ICC() calculates pointwise integrated ICC estimates. Conf_sets() computes confidence sets: "Rank" simultaneous ICC curve bands "Normal" integrated ICC confidence interval. plot_ICC() plots estimated ICC curve Rank confidence bands. pointwise_F_bands_ICC() calculates pointwise F-based confidence bands. pointwise bands provide simultaneous coverage. functions support "ICC(,1)" (single measurement) "ICC(,k)" (average measurement) designations documented. Supply matrices evaluation points columns. unbalanced "ICC(,1)" data, provide combined individual-ID vector test rows followed retest rows. package documentation describes data format methods detail.
